description.content: Metrics data ingestion operations

Ingests metrics data using JSON format. Accepts an array of metric objects containing metric name, type (counter, gauge, histogram, or summary), labels, timestamp, and value. This endpoint is ideal for custom applications and systems that generate metrics in JSON format rather than protocol buffers.
